AURORA STORM — Emerald and violet curtains ripple across the night sky above, casting wavering colored shadows across the snow-covered mountain pass where the traveler stands watching.
VOLCANIC ASH PLUME — A distant volcano erupts on the horizon, sending a towering column of orange-lit smoke that spreads across the sunset sky like a dark anvil.
WATERSPOUT FORMATION — Three massive waterspouts twist down from storm clouds in the bay's middle distance, their funnels connecting sea to sky in spinning gray columns.
METEOR SHOWER — Dozens of shooting stars streak overhead through the clear night, their burning trails creating temporary golden scratches across the constellation-filled darkness above the desert.
SANDSTORM WALL — A churning ochre wall advances across the dune sea on the horizon, hundreds of feet tall, blotting out the afternoon sun with its rolling approach.
DOUBLE RAINBOW — Two perfect arcs span the valley below after the rainfall, their vivid bands framing the distant waterfall in the midground against clearing clouds.
LIGHTNING WEB — Silent lightning spreads like branching veins throughout the massive thunderhead in the distance, illuminating its purple depths from within every few seconds.
BLOOD MOON RISING — An enormous copper-red moon crests the eastern hills, its eclipse-darkened face dominating the skyline and turning the landscape below into rust-colored shadows.
NOCTILUCENT CLOUDS — Electric-blue wisps shimmer in the twilight sky overhead, their ice-crystal formations glowing against the darkening atmosphere long after sunset has passed.
DUST DEVIL CLUSTER — Seven spinning columns dance across the plains in the middle distance, their funnels carrying debris and golden grass upward into the afternoon sky.
FOG BANK SURGE — Thick mist rolls over the coastal cliffs ahead, tumbling down the rockface like a slow waterfall of white vapor into the valley below.
SUPERCELL FORMATION — A rotating storm cell dominates the prairie horizon, its shelf cloud spinning slowly, green-tinted and pregnant with hail, advancing steadily forward across the grassland.
COMET APPEARANCE — A brilliant comet hangs in the pre-dawn sky overhead, its tail streaming across half the visible heavens in a blue-white banner of cosmic ice.
HABOOB APPROACH — The dust storm's leading edge towers over the scrubland ahead, a nearly vertical cliff of brown chaos racing forward with terrifying speed and scale.
SUN PILLAR — A vertical shaft of golden light extends from the setting sun on the western horizon, reaching high into the atmosphere like a celestial pillar.
SNOW SQUALL — Thick curtains of snow sweep across the frozen lake in the midground, the white walls moving visibly sideways, obscuring and revealing the far shore.
MOON HALO — A perfect circle of ice-refracted light surrounds the full moon overhead, its ring spanning twenty degrees of sky in pale spectral colors above the tundra.
VIRGA CURTAINS — Gray sheets of rain fall from distant clouds on the horizon but evaporate before reaching the ground, creating ghostly vertical streaks against the desert sky.
MAMMATUS CLOUDS — Bulging pouches hang from the storm's underside overhead, the bubble-like formations catching orange sunset light while the traveler gazes upward in wonder.
CREPUSCULAR RAYS — Golden spokes of sunlight beam through breaks in the cloud layer above, each shaft illuminating floating dust and creating divine-seeming columns in the sky.
TEMPERATURE INVERSION — The valley below fills with a perfect lake of clouds, their surface flat and white, with mountain peaks jutting through like islands at dawn.
ICE CRYSTAL HALO — Millions of tiny ice crystals catch the morning sun in the air ahead, creating a sparkling wall of floating diamonds across the frozen canyon.
KELVIN-HELMHOLTZ WAVES — The cloud layer overhead displays perfect breaking-wave patterns, their curling formations frozen in the sky like an ocean suspended above the mountain pass.
ASPERITAS FORMATION — The cloud base ripples in chaotic undulating waves overhead, their rough-textured undersides creating an upside-down stormy sea in the evening sky above.
MOONBOW ARCH — A faint spectral arc spans the misty gorge ahead, created by moonlight refracting through the waterfall's spray, ghostly white with hints of color.
